_readme: Real callback events overriding the heuristic 4-6wk window in tools/callback_windows.py. Keys are JC numbers. status interview|offer -> window cell replaced with window_cell (REQUIRED for every event status), row bolded; rejected|withdrawn -> replaced, no bold; ack -> suppresses scanner WARNs only for log lines containing a string in lines[] (a list), row unchanged. An event entry may carry ack_lines[] to silence an unrelated editorial false positive under the same JC. An event override suppresses only its own event class and the ones it implies (interview -> interview; offer -> interview+offer; rejected/withdrawn -> all), so a NEW later event still WARNs until the status here is updated. filing_dates holds a manual Final Filing Date (YYYY-MM-DD) for any JC whose posting PDF failed extraction; when both exist the manual date wins and a NOTE is printed. RULE: whenever a real interview/rejection/withdrawal/offer for a SUBMITTED JC is logged in PROGRESS_LOG.md, add the matching entry here in the same session, and keep the JC number on the event line or its heading so the scanner can key it.
